listings.name: [v1.1.0] Snooze-Manager (A Plug-in Collection)
listings.description: Snooze-Manager is a modular plug-in manager for Pengu Loader. Each QoL feature is implemented as a separate module, and the manager loads them together while keeping configuration consolidated. Everything is built to be lightweight and event driven: no embedded React application, no bloat, no constant polling of the client for changes and so on. Some features are inspired by earlier work, but the implementation here is independent and expanded to offer more than a straight copy.
listings.details: **Snooze-Manager v1.1.0 is out!** **What's new** The plugin is now fully translated - module names, settings labels, tooltips, status messages and toasts. Supported languages: English (default), Spanish, French, Korean, Chinese, Portuguese (Brazil) and Turkish. Switch language in Settings -> Language. Anything untranslated falls back to English. New module: **Use Client In Game** - dismisses the full-screen "game in progress" screen so you can browse the client (profile, collection, etc.) while a match is running. It comes back automatically after the game. **Auto Honor** has a new "Prefer Friends" option - honors your friends first within allies / enemies / random, with a heart badge on their honor cards. **Auto Select Champion** upgrades: - hover-then-lock with a configurable "Hover after X seconds" delay - "Respect Team Intent" - never auto-bans what a teammate intends to pick - "Allow Manual Pick" - your manual changes allow take over for current queued action - Searchable priority picker with champion icons and keyboard navigation - Bans are limited to the active bannable set; banned/already-picked champions are skipped - Lock timing is more accurate: "before turn ends" follows the live server timer, "after turn starts" measures from the actual turn start. - Renamed to "Auto Select" **Balance Tooltip**: - Swiftplay support alongside ARAM, Arena, Nexus Blitz, One For All, URF, Ultimate Spellbook. - Raw stat adjustments (+X / -X for base stats like health, armor, damage) now shown in Arena and Swiftplay, not just percentage modifiers. - Renamed to "Mode Balance Info". **Whale Helper**: - Tencent / CN client support with the full Chinese rarity system and gem icons; badges repositioned to avoid overlapping the chroma overlay. - Loot odds previewer now has a "[View]" link that lists every item in a drop pool with its icon and name. **Penalty UI Suppression**: - Now also suppresses the restriction-info warning tooltip (chat restriction, ranked restriction, redemption games), behind its own toggle. - Renamed from "Low Priority Warning Suppress"; old setting is migrated automatically. - Player-restriction warning section is hidden as well. Other improvements: - Mode Selector Tweaks: New hideable game modes (ARAM Mayhem, Mayhem (Classic), SR (Classic)); remaining cards keep a consistent layout instead of Riot's new compacted one - Auto Accept: new "Hide queue pop" option; lobby/champ-select dodge detection fixed - Queue labels for classic modes ("Normal", Mayhem (Classic), SR (Classic), customs, CO-OP SR) - Auto Queue: 5-second default delay before re-queue, so you can react Fixes: - Auto Honor: KDA/score badges now show up reliably (deferred until data is ready, with retries) - Auto Honor: multi-vote delay no longer applied after the last vote

listings.details:
## v1.2.3

### New Features
- **Summoner Reveal integration** — Merged the "Summoner Name Reveal" plugin (by @dakota1337x) into DodgeTracker as a built-in module:
  - Eye icon button in champ select controls
  - Sidebar showing player stats (rank, winrate, KDA, most common role)
  - OP.GG and Porofessor multi-search links
  - Toggle switch in settings (default OFF)
  - Reuses DodgeTracker's already-fetched summoner data (no duplicate API calls)
- **22-language support** for new `summonerRevealEnabled` and `summonerRevealDesc` translation keys

### Bug Fixes
- **`/lol-summoner/v2/summoners?ids=` returns HTTP 400 on Pengu v1.2** — Added `getSummonersByIds()` fallback: tries v2 batch endpoint first, falls back to individual `/lol-summoner/v1/summoners/{id}` lookups
- **Champ select loading too slow** — Replaced fixed 20-second delay with polling mechanism (checks every 1s, triggers when player count is stable + chat is ready, max 20s fallback)

### Improvements
- `playersFromChampSelect()` now returns `{ names, summoners }` so the Summoner Reveal module can reuse puuid data without duplicate API calls
- `removeRevealSidebar()` properly disconnects MutationObserver and cleans up all injected elements by class selector
- Eye icon button uses class-based selectors instead of id to prevent duplicate elements

---

## v1.2.3

### 新功能
- **融合召唤师信息（Summoner Reveal）** — 将 Summoner Name Reveal 插件（作者 @dakota1337x）融合到 DodgeTracker 中作为内置模块：
  - 选人阶段控制栏显示眼睛图标按钮
  - 侧边栏显示玩家战绩（段位、胜率、KDA、常玩位置）
  - OP.GG 和 Porofessor 多人查询链接
  - 设置面板开关控制（默认关闭）
  - 复用 DodgeTracker 已获取的召唤师数据，无需重复 API 调用
- **22 种语言**新增 `summonerRevealEnabled` 和 `summonerRevealDesc` 翻译键

### Bug 修复
- **`/lol-summoner/v2/summoners?ids=` 在 Pengu v1.2 返回 400** — 新增 `getSummonersByIds()` fallback：先尝试 v2 批量接口，失败则逐个调用 `/lol-summoner/v1/summoners/{id}`
- **选人阶段加载过慢** — 将固定 20 秒延迟改为轮询机制（每秒检查，玩家数量稳定 + 聊天室就绪即触发，最大兜底 20 秒）

### 优化
- `playersFromChampSelect()` 返回值改为 `{ names, summoners }`，供 Summoner Reveal 模块复用 puuid 数据
- `removeRevealSidebar()` 正确断开 MutationObserver 并按 class 清理所有注入元素
- 眼睛图标按钮改用 class 选择器替代 id，防止重复元素残留

listings.name: Kyso Clean Theme v2.0
listings.description: A simple and customizable league theme, without losing the "league experience"
listings.details:
This update focuses on fixing the "Self-Only" functionality (which restricts visual modifications to your own
  profile). These fixes ensure that crests and profile edits do not leak to other players' profiles when you are
  viewing them, even in more complex client rendering scenarios.

    **🐛 Bug Fixes**
    * **Self-Only Profile Detection**: Fixed own-profile detection to use more precise attributes (`summoner-id` /
  `puuid`) instead of name selectors, which were missing the actual real node in the client.
    * **Per-Surface Check**: Adjusted the code to validate profile ownership individually on each rendered surface.
  This resolves bugs that occurred because the League client can mount/render two profiles simultaneously in memory.
    * **Crest Self-ID Guard**: Fixed the `applyCrest` function so the "Self-Only" guard re-runs once your local ID is
  resolved, preventing your custom crest and icons from appearing on friends' profiles.

listings.description: A blackgame made for pengu loader to play in league
listings.details:
🃏 BLACKJACK ULTIMATE v2.0 — Pengu Loader Plugin

Full casino-style blackjack running right inside your League client.

Core rules
- Real blackjack with 6-deck shoe
- Double down, split pairs, surrender (get half back), insurance on dealer Ace
- Pays 3:2 | Dealer hits soft 17 | 5-Card Charlie auto-wins

Cool features
- Side bets: Perfect Pairs (up to 25:1) + 21+3 (up to 100:1)
- Play 1–3 hands at once
- Hi-Lo card counting (running + true count)
- Live basic strategy coach + explanations
- Real-time bust % if you hit
- XP system + 10 levels (Novice → Casino Legend)
- 15 persistent achievements
- Last 20 hands history
- Daily tournament (1000 starting chips, resets daily)
- 4 themes (Dark Velvet, Runeterra, Las Vegas, VIP Black)
- Sounds via Web Audio API + mute option
- Draggable & resizable floating window
- Saves balance, stats, XP, achievements & history across restarts

🆕 What's new in v2.0 — Elaina Theme compatibility
- Removed floating card button (was being blocked by Elaina)
- Game now opens with Alt+B from anywhere in the client
- CSS injected at the end of <head> to win cascade priority over Elaina
- MutationObserver keeps our styles last if Elaina reorders them
- Overlay uses isolation + contain to prevent Elaina CSS from bleeding in

How to play
- Press Alt+B to open / close the game
- Pick your bet chips → Deal
- Controls: Hit / Stand / Double / Split / Surrender
- Left sidebar: stats, toggles for coach, bust %, counting mode
